tools.name: search_funds
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): search Korean small business policy loans by Korean keywords (e.g. 청년, 재창업), province and purpose. Returns rate, limit in KRW, term, intake and source URL. 낱말·지역·용도로 정책자금 찾기.

tools.name: get_fund
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): one fund's rate, term, limit and lending channel per track, eligibility clauses with notice pages, intake status and FAQ. id comes from search_funds or check_eligibility. 자금 하나의 상세.

tools.name: find_industry_code
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): map an everyday Korean business word (e.g. 치킨, 미용실) to Korean Standard Industrial Classification (KSIC 11th) 5-digit codes for check_eligibility. 업종 일상어 → 표준산업분류 코드.

tools.name: define_term
tools.description: Money2Route(자금줄): plain-Korean explanation of policy loan terms such as 거치기간 (grace period) or 기준금리 (base rate). 정책자금 낱말 풀이.
